_about: Public-domain George Washington Doane (1799-1859), Episcopal Bishop of New Jersey and founder of Burlington College, for the Word Hoard: Songs by the Way (1824) and The Life and Writings of George Washington Doane (1860-61, four volumes, edited with a memoir by his son William Croswell Doane), which gather his sermons, charges, addresses and poems. from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 61 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
